description: This Java source file defines the IcsPaymentServices class, which provides services for integrating with CyberSource payment gateway, including methods for authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit operations. It constructs request maps, handles responses, and manages configuration properties for secure payment processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: IcsPaymentServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling CyberSource payment gateway transactions, including authorization, capture, release, refund, and credit operations, with configuration and response processing.

methods.name: buildCsProperties
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Properties object with CyberSource configuration based on the provided context and delegator.

methods.name: buildAuthRequest
methods.description: Builds a request map for authorization based on transaction context and configuration settings.

methods.name: buildCaptureRequest
methods.description: Creates a capture request map using authorization transaction details and context.

methods.name: buildReleaseRequest
methods.description: Creates a release (reversal) request map for a given authorization transaction.

methods.name: buildRefundRequest
methods.description: Prepares a refund request map for a specific authorization transaction and context.

methods.name: buildCreditRequest
methods.description: Constructs a credit request map for issuing refunds or credits.

methods.name: appendAvsRules
methods.description: Adds AVS decline code rules and ignore flags to the request.

methods.name: appendFullBillingInfo
methods.description: Populates billing, shipping, and credit card info into the request.

methods.name: appendItemLineInfo
methods.description: Adds order item line details to the request map.

methods.name: getAmountString
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount from context into a string with the correct scale and rounding.

methods.name: processAuthResult
methods.description: Processes the response map from authorization into result flags and messages.

methods.name: processCaptureResult
methods.description: Processes capture response into success flags and details.

methods.name: processReleaseResult
methods.description: Handles the response for release transactions, updating result map.

methods.name: processRefundResult
methods.description: Handles the response for refund transactions, updating result map.

methods.name: processCreditResult
methods.description: Handles the response for credit operations.

methods.name: getDecision
methods.description: Determines and returns the decision status ('ACCEPT', etc.) from the reply map.

methods.name: getPaymentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves configuration values for the CyberSource gateway either from the database or properties files, with optional defaults.
